sourceChecks.listingScope: Initial attempt retained one 50-entry public page each for train images, masks and georeferenced images. New strategy observed 750 unique train-mask IDs by ordinary public UI pagination, still a partial inventory. Publisher test contents not opened.

sourceChecks.reason: Initial attempt acquired two small train GeoJSON probes. Both near Lahore, not India. No file-to-Indian-city index found in checked metadata; no eligible image downloaded, no complete pair or alignment claim. New coordinate strategy sampled 24 additional train IDs from 750 publicly observed entries; all near Lahore. Public source preview is a SpaceNet Khartoum recipe, not a South Asia buffer/review policy.

evaluatorContract.building: Existing RF-DETR development evaluator requires image and truth/scoring masks in the exact image pixel frame; raw affine, CRS, source polygons, holes/partials and ignore policy must be pinned before admission
evaluatorContract.floor_plan: Existing CubiCasa evaluator uses 12 room/wall classes; native room SVG/vector annotations need exact source pixel frame and justified class mapping. A building polygon or document caption is not a floor-region target
